text:
incident-bot: PAGER DUTY ALERT: "kv-cache fragmentation high" on cluster serving-pool-3. Severity: P1. Triggers: continuous-batcher mem growth > 85% GPU, repeated cudaMalloc failures. Pager: irene. Thread started 2003456789

irene: got the page, I'm on it. :pager:

mike: seeing the same in grafana — fragmentation metric spiking and tail latency climbing. Several workers reporting `cudaMallocOutOfMemoryError` in logs.

ashley: quick snapshot of the cluster metrics I pulled: gpu_mem_used ~ 92% on nodes 3/8, kv_fragmentation_ratio 0.78, contbatch_inflight_requests jumped x4 after the canary at ~09:42UTC.

irene: initial hypothesis — a change in continuous batching config (auto-batch_window_ms tweak) pushed more micro-requests into longer-lived KV cache usage which prevented efficient eviction, causing arena fragmentation and eventual cuda malloc failures.

sam: if that's true, quick mitigation = disable continuous batching on prod pool-3 and roll back the canary. Can someone confirm who rolled that change?

mike: config owner for that rollout was @jordan but the deploy-bot shows a config push 2 hours ago: `configs/serve/continuous-batcher:v12 -> v13` with `batch_window_ms: 50 -> 120`.

ashley: logs from a failing worker:
```
E RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 256.00 MiB (GPU 0; 31.75 GiB total capacity; 29.40 GiB already allocated; 128.00 MiB free; 1.85 GiB reserved in arena)
  File "/srv/runtime/serve/kv_cache.py", line 316, in allocate_kv
    ptr = torch.cuda.memory_alloc(size)
```

irene: ok, mitigation plan (short term):
- disable continuous batching on serving-pool-3
- force compaction on workers (non-disruptive if possible)
- if compaction doesn't free enough, restart the hot workers (rolling) to reclaim fragmented arenas
- communicate customer impact

sam: I'll flip the batching flag. Doing via admin api now.

sam: POST /admin/pools/serving-pool-3/config {"continuous_batching": {"enabled": false}}  -> 200 OK

deploy-bot: config-change accepted by control-plane, initiating graceful drain of batchers on pool serving-pool-3.

ashley: after flip: contbatch_inflight_requests dropping, but fragmentation metric hasn't decreased yet — likely fragmentation persisted in arenas.

mike: trying compaction hook on a single worker: `adminctl compact-arena --worker=worker-3-7 --force` returned `compaction_started` and then `compaction_complete: reclaimed 2.1 GiB` for that worker.

ashley: good — compaction helped for worker-3-7. Running compaction across other hot workers in pool.

irene: keep compaction running, but we should plan for rolling restart for the ones that still show high reserved arena with low free.

sam: starting rolling restarts (max 1 pod at a time) on nodes with OOMs. Command:
```
kubectl rollout restart statefulset/serve-worker -n prod --selector=pool=serving-pool-3
```

ashley: note — customers using long-context endpoints might see transient 5xx for requests served by a restarting pod. We should set fallback routing to healthy pools (serving-pool-1/2) for critical customers.

mike: initiated routing fallback for VIP customers via routing policy change. Patch applied.

irene: status update — compaction across 5/6 hot workers done, rolling restart in progress (2/6 restarted). Error rate for affected endpoints is trending down from 12% -> 3%.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity remains P1, customer impact reduced to degraded for a subset of long-context flows. Next update in 15 minutes.

sam: we also should throttle batching for canary config globally until we understand memory pattern. I'll revert the config change for the canary namespace and pin v12.

sam: Reverting `configs/serve/continuous-batcher` to v12 in canary and prod. API returned 200 for both.

ashley: investigating root allocator behavior — pyro profiler shows lots of small free segments that can't be coalesced due to fragmentation; underlying cudamalloc still can't satisfy large allocations even after partial compaction.

mike: FYI I ran a non-disruptive patch on the allocator to enable more aggressive background defragmentation: `LD_PRELOAD=/opt/lib/libarena_defrag.so` via a feature flag on 2 workers; early signs show reclaimed reserved arena faster. Not safe to roll wide without QA but promising.

irene: good experimentation. For now we keep the destructive step (full restart) for the stubborn workers only. Keep me posted.

ashley: client-facing status: we should send a brief note — impacted customers see higher latency and some 5xxs on long-context API calls; short-context traffic unaffected. I'll draft.

ashley: DRAFT: "We're investigating increased latency and errors for long-context inference. Our oncall team identified a runtime memory fragmentation issue triggered by a recent batching config change. We've disabled the new batching behavior and are mitigating with targeted restarts and cache compaction. Short-term: degraded for long-context endpoints only. We'll follow up with a postmortem."

irene: send to customer-ops once you finish. Also create an incident ticket linking to this thread.

mike: ticket created: INC-2026-412. Attached logs and steps taken.

sam: rolling restart completed for the remaining 4 hot pods. Post-restart metrics: gpu_mem_used down to ~60% on previously hot nodes, kv_fragmentation_ratio down to 0.22.

ashley: error rate now <1% for most endpoints; two customers still on fallback route but no ongoing failures.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLUTION CHECK: can we move to P2 and schedule a formal postmortem? Please ack if resolved.

irene: ack. Moving to P2. Will run the postmortem and owners: ashley (troubleshooting), sam (config rollout), mike (allocator/defrag). Target postmortem doc by EOD tomorrow.

sam: immediate action items created:
- revert batching v13 and mark it as blocked until mem/regression tests added (owner: sam)
- add canary health gate for kv_fragmentation_ratio >= 0.5 (owner: sam)
- admin API: add an atomic `evict-shard` endpoint for emergency KV eviction (owner: ashley)

mike: infra action items:
- add automated compaction trigger when fragmentation ratio > 0.65 (owner: mike)
- test libarena_defrag in staging and run perf testing (owner: mike)

ashley: customer ops action items:
- send update to affected customers with timeline and mitigation summary (owner: ashley)

irene: thanks all. I'll keep watch on metrics for next 2 hours then hand back to standard oncall.

deploy-bot: config v12 pinned. v13 blocked: true. Canary disabled.

ashley: sent customer update via support channel, links to status page and this thread.

mike: follow-up note — we should add tests in CI that simulate heavy continuous-batching with long-lived KV handles to catch fragmentation regressions earlier.

irene: agreed. Closing the pager for now. If anything regresses, re-open this thread.

incident-bot: Pager cleared by irene at 2003457050. Thread archived after P2 transition.
